title: Lost Mary BM600 Mint Tobacco Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: The Mint Tobacco Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pods combine earthy Tobacco with a clean Mint edge. The result is a balanced flavour that blends richness with freshness for an all-day option. Each pack contains two 2ml pods prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, lasting up to 600 puffs per pod depending on usage. With a smooth mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw, these pods provide reliable satisfaction with no messy refills or coil changes. Made for the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pod Kit, installation is simple and clean: click a pod into place and enjoy classic flavour with a cool lift.
